question: 美国股票与国债ETF的月末相对价格规律，是否支持进一步研究个人低频执行日期
scope: external financial-mechanism candidate, not existing LEI technical rule
native_technical_workflow: unsupported; do not claim native workflow passed; independent bound study using current standards
hypothesis: 股票相对债券上涨造成股票配置超目标，受固定配置约束机构在月底卖股买债，随后股票相对债券收益较低；相反偏离方向相反
competing_explanations: 不依赖股债偏离的日历效应
机构并非统一月底/统一60比40调仓
mechanism_limit: 没有机构逐笔持仓和交易，价格关联不能识别因果；漂移是月内股债总回报比的确定变换

paper.original: ES/TY futures, daily updated signal predicts next day; final five-day window selected after comparison
paper.adaptation: SPY/IEF, one signal at sixth-last close monthly, subsequent five closes; not exact replication

signal.known_time: after that day's final prices; historical vendor arrival unknown
signal.future_information: outcomes may not enter signal, sample eligibility or fitted coefficients

target.primary: SPY total return minus IEF total return, signal close to month-end close, five trading intervals
target.secondary: next actual open to month-end close, excludes entry-day ex-dividend entitlement
target.distributions: cash dividend reinvested at ex-date close, hypothetical economic-return calculation; payment lag ignored
target.missing: reject asymmetric dates or missing/nonpositive prices; no fill; immature month omitted explicitly

fixed_comparators: expanding OLS on stock-only month-to-date log total return
expanding OLS on month-to-date stock/bond log total-return ratio

prediction.training: expanding, label_end strictly before current signal_date
prediction.primary_metric: paired mean squared prediction error, drift versus relative log-return comparator

phenomenon.primary_description: negative sign of drift times subsequent relative return; balanced sign groups and regression interpretation separately
phenomenon.placebo: signal ten common trading sessions earlier; same formation length as corresponding month-end event, five-session target
phenomenon.uncertainty: circular block resampling consecutive 12-month blocks, 5000 draws, seed 20261020; describe intervals, not probability of hypothesis
sensitivity: raw close/dividend reconstruction versus vendor adjusted series
phenomenon.all_outcomes: retain winners/losers, worst/best months; no threshold selection
phenomenon.calendar_control: paired monthly pooled OLS y ~ 1 + EOM + relative_log + EOM*relative_log; slope interaction with 5000 circular 12-month block draws, monthly pairs kept together; no interval for fewer than24 months
phenomenon.signed_difference_limit: descriptive only, not sufficient to exclude calendar mean return

decision.use: prioritize or pause execution-date research; no immediate trade trigger or hard filter
decision.continue_condition: direction and magnitude offer credible useful evidence beyond simple controls and survive calendar, crisis and execution-time checks; if not, do not build timing policy to chase gains
decision.cost_scenarios: 5/10/20 basis points per shifted dollar are illustrative hurdle levels only; not claimed actual account costs
decision.practical_minimum: unknown until actual holding and feasible execution schedule; do not claim equivalence or rule out all useful effects
decision.stopping: answer the bounded applicability question, including negative or insufficient evidence; no parameter sweep

known_limitations: One market and one preselected surviving ETF pair; cannot extrapolate to mainland ETF calendars, FX, taxes or premiums
2026 is retrospective after this paper version, not verified unseen or real-time forward observation
Model expression gain is not independent new raw information
No full LEI policy or account return comparison unless this first test justifies a separate frozen use
